action: No action needed; for awareness. The article reports no advice from KEPCO or the PIPC for affected users.
date_note: Day KEPCO reported the leak to the PIPC, as stated by Inews24; the article is dated 25 November and does not say when the breach itself occurred.

evidence.quote: 고객 서비스 플랫폼 '한전ON' 이용자 65만 487명과 전자조달시스템(SRM) 이용자 86만 9761명
개보위는 한전 개인정보 유출 사고를 20억원 상한의 일반 과징금 검토 대상으로 판단하고 있다.

exec: Korea's data regulator treats a KEPCO leak as a major incident and is weighing a fine.
geo_basis: country of the organisation; no city stated
plain: Korea's state power company KEPCO told the privacy regulator that personal data leaked from its customer platform and a procurement system. The regulator is weighing a fine.
summary: Inews24 reports that KEPCO told South Korea's Personal Information Protection Commission (PIPC) on 22 November that personal data of 1,520,248 people leaked, from the 한전ON customer platform (650,487 users) and the SRM procurement system (869,761 users). The PIPC has designated it a major incident and sent a rapid-response team, and is considering the general fine, capped at 2 billion won. The article does not say how the leak happened.
title: KEPCO reports a personal data leak to Korea's privacy regulator

validation.note: Single publisher (Inews24), which reports KEPCO's own filing with the PIPC and the PIPC's response; a second publisher was not found.
